blocks.tex: Let $C$ be an abelian category. Spectral sequences in $C$ have pages given by cycle and boundary quotients, and converge by identifying their infinity pages with associated graded objects of filtered targets. For a filtered map, extension relations record equations between filtered representatives; bounded filtrations yield an extension spectral sequence.

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:sequence
blocks.title: A spectral sequence in an abelian category
blocks.body: Let $C$ be an abelian category and let the grading group be additive. A spectral sequence consists of nested cycle and boundary subobjects, their quotient pages, differentials of the specified degree with square zero, and compatible identifications of successor pages with homology. The same ambient data determine $E_\infty$.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.SSData
lean.code:
public structure SSData (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] where
  /-- Ambient object. -/
  V : C
  /-- The decreasing family of cycle subobjects. -/
  Z : WithTop ℕ → Subobject V
  /-- The increasing family of boundary subobjects. -/
  B : WithTop ℕ → Subobject V
  /-- Cycles decrease with the page. -/
  Z_anti : Antitone Z
  /-- Boundaries increase with the page. -/
  B_mono : Monotone B
  /-- Every element is a zero-cycle. -/
  Z_zero : Z 0 = ⊤
  /-- Boundaries are cycles on every page. -/
  B_le_Z : ∀ r, B r ≤ Z r
  /-- `Z ⊤` is the infimum of the finite cycle stages. -/
  Z_top_greatest : ∀ (X : Subobject V), (∀ i : ℕ, X ≤ Z ↑i) → X ≤ Z ⊤
  /-- `B ⊤` is the supremum of the finite boundary stages. -/
  B_top_least : ∀ (X : Subobject V), (∀ i : ℕ, B ↑i ≤ X) → B ⊤ ≤ X

lean.code:
public structure SpectralSequence (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (ι : Type w) [AddCommGroup ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    extends SpectralSequence.PreSS C ι where
  /-- Every page differential squares to zero. -/
  d_comp_d : ∀ (r : ℤ) (k : ι), d r k ≫ d r (k + diffDeg r) = 0
  /-- The kernel of `d_r` is the image of `Z_(r+1)` on page `r`. -/
  Z_succ : ∀ (r : ℤ) (k : ι) (_ : r₀ ≤ r),
    let n := (r - r₀).toNat
    kernelSubobject (d r k) =
      imageSubobject (Subobject.ofLE
        ((ssData k).Z ↑(n + 1)) ((ssData k).Z ↑n)
        ((ssData k).Z_anti (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n)) ≫
        (ssData k).pageπ ↑n)
  /-- The image of `d_r` is the image of `B_(r+1)` on page `r`. -/
  B_succ : ∀ (r : ℤ) (k : ι) (_ : r₀ ≤ r),
    let n := (r - r₀).toNat
    imageSubobject (d r k) =
      imageSubobject (Subobject.ofLE
        ((ssData (k + diffDeg r)).B ↑(n + 1))
        ((ssData (k + diffDeg r)).Z ↑n)
        (le_trans ((ssData (k + diffDeg r)).B_le_Z ↑(n + 1))
          ((ssData (k + diffDeg r)).Z_anti (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n))) ≫
        (ssData (k + diffDeg r)).pageπ ↑n)

comments.title: Interface scope: generic-sequence-signatures
comments.text:
Scope of the related interface family `generic-sequence-signatures`. This note does not assert equivalence with a broader paper statement or mark any proof complete.


- **mathematical_purpose**: Given a spectral sequence in an abelian category: actual pages, differential, cycle/boundary towers and successor homology.

- **interface_role**: SpectralSequence is supplied data with structural laws. SSData, PreSS and GradedComplex remain signature foundations, not an assertion that a concrete Adams model has been constructed.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Page r is the specified Z/B quotient with its actual quotient map; d squares to zero and respects the declared differential degree.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: The same ambient SSData supports all finite pages and E∞. The successor-page compatibility is retained in the SpectralSequence fields.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: The core is generic in the abelian category and grading group. The specialized element-label predicates remain over ModuleCat R and bidegrees; synthetic tridegrees use this generic core directly.

- **boundary**: No public ofPreSS or DifferentialMorphismCriterion construction adapter.

- **boundary**: SSData cannot be made private while its V/Z/B/pageπ fields form these mathematical signatures.

- **boundary**: Unconsumed EInftyData and GradedSSData convenience wrappers are private; they are not needed to state the retained contracts.

comments.author: metadata-migration
comments.title: Module interface conventions
comments.text:
Module-level interface conventions; completion remains derived from verified Lean evidence.

- **principle**: Generic spectral-sequence definitions and proved operations retain genuine mathematical parameters. Project consumers obtain their fixed sequence and comparisons from AdamsSynthetic.Standard. SpectralSequence has no admitted declarations.

- **type_authority.api_manifest**: metadata/spectral-sequence-api.json

- **type_authority.source_manifest**: metadata/spectral-sequence-sources.json

- **type_authority.rule**: Exact elaborated types, universe levels and typeclass assumptions are frozen by the API manifest and Lean source. This ledger classifies purpose and evidence; abbreviated mathematical prose is not a replacement signature.

- **classification.mathematical-definition-or-operation**: An explicit public definition, predicate, data structure, abbreviation or operation that states or operates on a mathematical contract.

- **classification.proved-operation**: An explicit public theorem/lemma whose conclusion is derived from the declared hypotheses. The capture kind field alone does not reliably distinguish these from compiler-generated declarations.

- **classification.required-type-support**: Explicit foundational structures or instances needed to state or use retained signatures, including SSData, PreSS, underlying morphism records, and the public categories. They are not counted as independent domain capabilities.

- **classification.generated-signature-support**: Lean-emitted structure fields, constructors, parent projections and required instances. These may be essential mathematical inputs even though they are emitted automatically; associate them with the owning explicit structure.

- **classification.generated-elaboration-support**: Recursors, noConfusion, equation lemmas, auxiliary _proof declarations and derived compiler helpers. These do not independently justify an additional consumer-facing mathematical capability.

- **classification.counting_rule**: Do not equate export count, explicit public-command count or compiler-generated declaration count with the number of contracts. Do not use numerical reduction alone to justify hiding a mathematical operation.

- **private_implementation_boundary**: FilteredComplex construction and its representative/fiber machinery

- **private_implementation_boundary**: BoundedExtension.underlyingComplex and compatibility construction proofs

- **private_implementation_boundary**: ModuleSubobject and ModuleQuotient construction lemmas

- **private_implementation_boundary**: DifferentialMorphismCriterion and ofPreSS adapters

- **private_implementation_boundary**: Generic crossing predicates whose mathematical strength does not coincide with the precise Adams page-extension contracts

- **private_implementation_boundary**: Algebra support under SpectralSequence/Internal/Algebra; only retained SpectralSequence contracts and the F2 coefficient alias are public.

blocks.title: Adams pages and extension lengths
blocks.body: An Adams page carries an integer value $r\geq2$. An extension length is a nonnegative integer and may be zero. A page-level convention relates the page index, cycle level, and quotient exponent compatibly with successors. An extension length $n$ determines an Adams page when $n\geq2$.

public structure PreSSMorphism
    {ι : Type w} [AddCommGroup ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (E E' : PreSS C ι) extends SSDataMorphism ι E.ssData E'.ssData where
  /-- Ordinary morphisms use the same displayed page numbering. -/
  r₀_eq : E.r₀ = E'.r₀
  /-- Ordinary morphisms preserve the differential degree on each page. -/
  diffDeg_eq : E.diffDeg = E'.diffDeg
  /-- The induced maps on pages commute with the differentials. -/
  comm_d : ∀ (r : ℤ) (k : ι),
    toSSDataMorphism.pageMapAt r₀_eq r k ≫ E'.d r k =
      E.d r k ≫ toSSDataMorphism.pageMapAt r₀_eq r (k + E.diffDeg r) ≫
        eqToHom (by rw [diffDeg_eq])

lean.code:
public structure SpectralSequenceMorphism
    {ι : Type w} [AddCommGroup ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (E E' : SpectralSequence C ι) where
  /-- Map on each ambient object. -/
  φ : ∀ (k : ι), (E.ssData k).V ⟶ (E'.ssData k).V
  /-- The ambient maps preserve cycles. -/
  preserves_Z : ∀ (k : ι) (r : WithTop ℕ),
    ∃ (lift : Subobject.underlying.obj ((E.ssData k).Z r) ⟶
      Subobject.underlying.obj ((E'.ssData k).Z r)),
      lift ≫ ((E'.ssData k).Z r).arrow = ((E.ssData k).Z r).arrow ≫ φ k
  /-- The ambient maps preserve boundaries. -/
  preserves_B : ∀ (k : ι) (r : WithTop ℕ),
    ∃ (lift : Subobject.underlying.obj ((E.ssData k).B r) ⟶
      Subobject.underlying.obj ((E'.ssData k).B r)),
      lift ≫ ((E'.ssData k).B r).arrow = ((E.ssData k).B r).arrow ≫ φ k
  /-- Ordinary morphisms have the same displayed page numbering. -/
  r₀_eq : E.r₀ = E'.r₀
  /-- Ordinary morphisms have the same differential degrees. -/
  diffDeg_eq : E.diffDeg = E'.diffDeg
  /-- The canonical quotient maps commute with the differentials. -/
  comm_d : ∀ (r : ℤ) (k : ι),
    let f : SSDataMorphism ι E.ssData E'.ssData :=
      { φ := φ, preserves_Z := preserves_Z, preserves_B := preserves_B }
    f.pageMapAt (E := E.toPreSS) (E' := E'.toPreSS) r₀_eq r k ≫ E'.d r k =
      E.d r k ≫ f.pageMapAt (E := E.toPreSS) (E' := E'.toPreSS)
        r₀_eq r (k + E.diffDeg r) ≫ eqToHom (by rw [diffDeg_eq])

comments.author: metadata-migration
comments.title: Interface scope: morphisms-and-naturality
comments.text:
Scope of the related interface family `morphisms-and-naturality`. This note does not assert equivalence with a broader paper statement or mark any proof complete.


- **mathematical_purpose**: Use a single functorial family and its induced maps on ambient objects, cycles, finite pages and E∞.

- **interface_role**: Public morphism records and Category instances give composition and equality; proved naturality operations let downstream transport representative and differential statements.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: A spectral-sequence morphism preserves the same cycle/boundary towers and commutes with the actual differential, including degree transport.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Finite-page and infinity maps are induced by that same morphism, not separately supplied unrelated maps.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Identity/composition and representative transport are proved from these records. The PreSS category remains needed by retained PreSSMorphism operation signatures.

- **boundary**: PreSS.forget, equivPreSSMorphism, inclusion, their Full/Faithful witnesses and the duplicate toUnderlying adapter have no current or searched fixed-source consumer; they remain implemented privately.

- **boundary**: Generated parent projections such as SSDataMorphism.toUnderlyingMorphism are signature support and are distinct from the removed hand-written toUnderlying convenience definition.


Code provenance: [KIPSource5aa845241533](https://github.com/SII-MATH/Kervaire126/tree/5aa845241533), [KIPSource871b3be8f46a](https://github.com/SII-MATH/Kervaire126/tree/871b3be8f46a), [KIPSourcebbac1fc05843](https://github.com/SII-MATH/Kervaire126/tree/bbac1fc05843). Exact original source blocks and migration history remain in `local-history/metadata/spectral-sequence-sources.json`.

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:representatives
blocks.title: A label represented on a later page
blocks.body: For a module-valued spectral sequence, $x\in E_2^p$ represents $x_r\in E_r^p$ if one cycle representative projects to both classes. Reaching $E_r$ means such a representative exists; surviving to $E_r$ additionally requires $x_r\neq0$.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.ReachesPage
lean.code:
public def ReachesPage
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (r : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p) : Prop :=
  ∃ xr : E.Page r p, RepresentsOnPage E r p x xr

A label has a representative on the stated page; its class there may
be zero. This is the cycle information stored by an unresolved outgoing

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.RepresentsOnPage
lean.code:
public def RepresentsOnPage {R : Type u} [Ring R]
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (r : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p) (y : E.Page r p) : Prop :=
  ∃ hr : 2 ≤ r,
    let D := E.ssData p
    let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat
    let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r - E.r₀).toNat
    ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z m) : ModuleCat R),
      (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z m) (D.Z n) (D.Z_anti (by
        change (↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ) ≤ ↑(r - E.r₀).toNat
        exact_mod_cast (show (2 - E.r₀).toNat ≤ (r - E.r₀).toNat by omega))) ≫
        D.pageπ n) z = x ∧ D.pageπ m z = y

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:representatives-unique
blocks.title: Uniqueness and transport of representatives
blocks.body: A fixed $E_2$ label has at most one represented class on a specified later page. Spectral-sequence morphisms transport representatives and differential equations through their induced page maps.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.SpectralSequenceMorphism.hasDifferential
lean.code:
public theorem SpectralSequenceMorphism.hasDifferential
    {E E' : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ)}
    (f : SpectralSequenceMorphism E E') {r : ℤ} {p q : ℤ × ℤ}
    {x : E.Page 2 p} {y : E.Page 2 q} (h : HasDifferential E r p q x y) :
    HasDifferential E' r p q (f.pageMap 2 p x) (f.pageMap 2 q y) := by
  have hdegree : ∀ (r : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ),
      id (p + E.diffDeg r) = id p + E'.diffDeg r := by
    intro r p
    rw [f.diffDeg_eq]
    rfl
  have hf := f.toSSDataMorphism.hasDifferential_reindexed (E := E) (E' := E')
    (τ := id) f.r₀_eq hdegree (fun r p => by
      convert f.pageMap_comm_d r p using 1 <;> rfl) h
  convert hf using 1 <;> rfl
lean.docstring:
Differential equations between named E₂ representatives are natural.
The image equation can have zero source or target.

lean.code:
public theorem RepresentsOnPage.unique
    {E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ)} {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ}
    {x : E.Page 2 p} {yr zr : E.Page r p}
    (hy : RepresentsOnPage E r p x yr) (hz : RepresentsOnPage E r p x zr) :
    yr = zr := by
  obtain ⟨hr, y, hxy, hy⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨_, z, hxz, hz⟩ := hz
  have hnm : (↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ) ≤ ↑(r - E.r₀).toNat := by
    exact_mod_cast (show (2 - E.r₀).toNat ≤ (r - E.r₀).toNat by omega)
  exact hy.symm.trans (((E.ssData p).page_eq_of_early_page_eq _ _ hnm y z
    (hxy.trans hxz.symm)).trans hz)
lean.docstring:
A fixed E₂ label has at most one actual continuation on any later page.
This does not assert that a continuation exists.

    {E E' : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ)}
    (f : SpectralSequenceMorphism E E') {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ}
    {x : E.Page 2 p} {y : E.Page r p} (h : RepresentsOnPage E r p x y) :

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:cycles-boundaries
blocks.title: Cycles, boundaries, and incoming hits
blocks.body: A page-$r$ cycle is an element $x_r\in\ker d_r$, and a page-$r$ boundary is an element of $\operatorname{im}d_r$. A second-page label is a boundary by page $r$ if it lifts from the boundary subobject at page $r+1$; it is a final boundary if it lifts from $B_\infty$. An incoming hit on page $r$ is a differential whose represented target is nonzero.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.NeverHit

public def NeverHit {R : Type u} [Ring R]
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p) : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : ℤ) (_ : 2 ≤ r) (q : ℤ × ℤ) (h : q + E.diffDeg r = p)
    (y : E.Page r p), RepresentsOnPage E r p x y → y ≠ 0 →
    ∀ z : E.Page r q, (E.d r q ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (E.Page r) h)) z ≠ y

    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))

    ∃ b : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.B m) : ModuleCat R),
      (Subobject.ofLE (D.B m) (D.B ⊤) (D.B_mono le_top) ≫
        Subobject.ofLE (D.B ⊤) (D.Z ⊤) (D.B_le_Z ⊤) ≫
        Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z n) (D.Z_anti le_top) ≫ D.pageπ n) b = x

comments.author: metadata-migration
comments.title: Interface scope: page-labels-and-finite-state
comments.text:
Scope of the related interface family `page-labels-and-finite-state`. This note does not assert equivalence with a broader paper statement or mark any proof complete.


- **mathematical_purpose**: Express named E₂ labels, later-page representatives, cycles, boundaries, nonzero finite survival and specified differentials.

- **interface_role**: Predicates state actual properties of a supplied sequence; the public theorems derive consequences without adding assumptions to a global model.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: RepresentsOnPage requires one cycle representative for the E₂ and Eᵣ labels, with 2 ≤ r. There is no map from all of E₂ to Eᵣ.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: SurvivesTo means a nonzero continuation on that page; ReachesPage permits zero. Survival to Eᵣ does not assert dᵣ=0.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: HasDifferential allows a zero target; HasNonzeroDifferential requires the actual later-page target to be nonzero.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: IsPageBoundary includes zero. NeverHit excludes only nonzero incoming hits and does not eliminate outgoing differentials.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: DifferentialVanishesOn and DifferentialTargets quantify over continuations and do not assert that any continuation exists.

- **boundary**: The bidegree specialization is kept for existing classical labels; no speculative rewrite of every element predicate to a general grading is required for current synthetic consumers.


Code provenance: [KIPSource5aa845241533](https://github.com/SII-MATH/Kervaire126/tree/5aa845241533), [KIPSource871b3be8f46a](https://github.com/SII-MATH/Kervaire126/tree/871b3be8f46a), [KIPSourcebbac1fc05843](https://github.com/SII-MATH/Kervaire126/tree/bbac1fc05843). Exact original source blocks and migration history remain in `local-history/metadata/spectral-sequence-sources.json`.

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:differential
blocks.title: Differentials between named labels
blocks.body: For $x\in E_2^p$ and $y\in E_2^q$, the relation $d_r(x)=y$ means that $q=p+\deg(d_r)$ and that there exist classes $x_r,y_r$ represented by $x,y$, respectively, satisfying $d_r(x_r)=y_r$. The differential is nonzero when $y_r\neq0$. Differential vanishing on $x$ means that every page-$r$ class represented by $x$ has zero outgoing differential; this condition also holds when $x$ has no page-$r$ representative.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.DifferentialTargets
lean.code:
public def DifferentialTargets {R : Type u} [Ring R]
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (r : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p)
    (y : E.Page 2 (p + E.diffDeg r)) : Prop :=
  ∀ xr : E.Page r p, RepresentsOnPage E r p x xr →
    E.d r p xr = 0 ∨
      ∃ yr : E.Page r (p + E.diffDeg r),
        RepresentsOnPage E r (p + E.diffDeg r) y yr ∧ E.d r p xr = yr
lean.statement:
public def DifferentialTargets {R : Type u} [Ring R]
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (r : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p)
    (y : E.Page 2 (p + E.diffDeg r)) : Prop :=
  ∀ xr : E.Page r p, RepresentsOnPage E r p x xr →
    E.d r p xr = 0 ∨
      ∃ yr : E.Page r (p + E.diffDeg r),
        RepresentsOnPage E r (p + E.diffDeg r) y yr ∧ E.d r p xr = yr
lean.docstring:
Every differential on a continuation is zero or represented by the
specified target. The nonzero alternative is not assumed to occur.

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:nonzero-differential
blocks.title: Consequences of a nonzero differential
blocks.body: A nonzero differential gives nonzero representatives of both source and target on its page, hits the specified target, and implies that the actual differential morphism is nonzero.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.HasNonzeroDifferential.source_survives
lean.code:
public theorem HasNonzeroDifferential.source_survives
    (h : HasNonzeroDifferential E r p q x y) : SurvivesTo E r p x := by
  obtain ⟨hdeg, xr, yr, hx, _, heq, hne⟩ := h
  refine ⟨xr, hx, ?_⟩
  intro hz
  apply hne
  rw [hz] at heq
  simpa using heq.symm
lean.statement:
public theorem HasNonzeroDifferential.source_survives
    (h : HasNonzeroDifferential E r p q x y) : SurvivesTo E r p x

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:windows
blocks.title: Survival on a finite window
blocks.body: Let $2\leq a\leq b$. A label is a cycle on the window $[a,b]$ if, for every integer $r$ in this interval, it represents a class $x_r$ with $d_r(x_r)=0$. It survives on this window if it represents a nonzero class on every page in the interval. It is never hit on this window if no page in the interval has a nonzero incoming differential with that represented target.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.IsCycleOnWindow
lean.code:
public def IsCycleOnWindow
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (first last : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ first ∧ first ≤ last ∧
    ∀ r : ℤ, first ≤ r → r ≤ last →
      ∃ xr : E.Page r p, RepresentsOnPage E r p x xr ∧ IsPageCycle E r p xr
lean.statement:
public def IsCycleOnWindow
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (first last : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ first ∧ first ≤ last ∧
    ∀ r : ℤ, first ≤ r → r ≤ last →
      ∃ xr : E.Page r p, RepresentsOnPage E r p x xr ∧ IsPageCycle E r p xr
lean.docstring:
Actual continuation and zero outgoing differential on every page
in the specified nonempty window. Incoming boundaries and zero classes
are allowed. Unlike a universal implication on continuations, this
condition asserts that the continuations exist.

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:permanent
blocks.title: Permanent cycles and nonzero survival
blocks.body: A permanent cycle is an $E_2$ label with a common representative in $Z_\infty$. Nonzero survival requires that this representative have nonzero image in $E_\infty$. In both cases the infinite-cycle representative projects to the original $E_2$ label.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.infinityToPage

    (r : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) : InfiniteCycles E p ⟶ E.Page r p :=
  Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((E.ssData p).Z_anti le_top) ≫
    (E.ssData p).pageπ ↑(r - E.r₀).toNat

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.IsPermanentCycle
lean.code:
public def IsPermanentCycle
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p) : Prop :=
  let D := E.ssData p
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat
  ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z ⊤) : ModuleCat R),
    (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ⊤) (D.Z n) (D.Z_anti le_top) ≫ D.pageπ n) z = x

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:stabilization
blocks.title: Stabilization after vanishing differentials
blocks.body: If all outgoing differentials at a fixed degree vanish from page $N$ onward, its cycle tower stabilizes there. If the corresponding incoming differential morphisms vanish, its boundary tower stabilizes as well. The page $N$ must be at least the initial page.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.boundaries_top_eq_of_d_eq_zero
lean.code:
public theorem boundaries_top_eq_of_d_eq_zero
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [Abelian C]
    {ι : Type*} [AddCommGroup ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (E : SpectralSequence C ι) (N : ℤ) (hN : E.r₀ ≤ N) (k : ι)
    (hd : ∀ r : ℤ, N ≤ r → E.d r (k - E.diffDeg r) = 0) :
    (E.ssData k).B ⊤ = (E.ssData k).B ↑(N - E.r₀).toNat := by
  let n₀ := (N - E.r₀).toNat
  let D := E.ssData k
  have hn₀ : (n₀ : ℤ) = N - E.r₀ := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
  have htail : ∀ m : ℕ, D.B (↑(n₀ + m) : WithTop ℕ) = D.B ↑n₀ := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      have hb := boundaries_succ_of_zero E (E.r₀ + (n₀ + m : ℕ)) (by omega)
        (k - E.diffDeg (E.r₀ + (n₀ + m : ℕ)))
        (hd _ (by rw [Nat.cast_add, hn₀]; omega))
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, Int.toNat_natCast] at hb
      have hb' : D.B ↑(n₀ + m + 1) = D.B ↑(n₀ + m) :=
        (congrArg (fun j => (E.ssData j).B ↑(n₀ + m + 1) =
          (E.ssData j).B ↑(n₀ + m))
          (sub_add_cancel k (E.diffDeg (E.r₀ + (n₀ + m : ℕ))))).mp hb
      exact hb'.trans ih
  apply le_antisymm _ (D.B_mono le_top)
  apply D.B_top_least
  intro n
  by_cases hn : n₀ ≤ n
  · have h := (htail (n - n₀)).le
    simpa only [Nat.add_sub_of_le hn] using h
  · exact D.B_mono (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hn))
lean.statement:
public theorem boundaries_top_eq_of_d_eq_zero
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [Abelian C]
    {ι : Type*} [AddCommGroup ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (E : SpectralSequence C ι) (N : ℤ) (hN : E.r₀ ≤ N) (k : ι)
    (hd : ∀ r : ℤ, N ≤ r → E.d r (k - E.diffDeg r) = 0) :
    (E.ssData k).B ⊤ = (E.ssData k).B ↑(N - E.r₀).toNat
lean.docstring:
Vanishing of all later incoming differentials stabilizes the boundaries
at this grading, including the actual union at infinity.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.cycles_top_eq_of_d_eq_zero
lean.code:
public theorem cycles_top_eq_of_d_eq_zero
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [Abelian C]
    {ι : Type*} [AddCommGroup ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (E : SpectralSequence C ι) (N : ℤ) (hN : E.r₀ ≤ N) (k : ι)
    (hd : ∀ r : ℤ, N ≤ r → E.d r k = 0) :
    (E.ssData k).Z ⊤ = (E.ssData k).Z ↑(N - E.r₀).toNat := by
  let n₀ := (N - E.r₀).toNat
  let D := E.ssData k
  have hn₀ : (n₀ : ℤ) = N - E.r₀ := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
  have htail : ∀ m : ℕ, D.Z (↑(n₀ + m) : WithTop ℕ) = D.Z ↑n₀ := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      have hz := cycles_succ_of_zero E (E.r₀ + (n₀ + m : ℕ)) (by omega) k
        (hd _ (by rw [Nat.cast_add, hn₀]; omega))
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, Int.toNat_natCast] at hz
      exact hz.trans ih
  apply le_antisymm (D.Z_anti le_top)
  apply D.Z_top_greatest
  intro n
  by_cases hn : n₀ ≤ n
  · have h := (htail (n - n₀)).ge
    simpa only [Nat.add_sub_of_le hn] using h
  · exact D.Z_anti (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hn))

    (hd : ∀ r : ℤ, N ≤ r → E.d r k = 0) :
    (E.ssData k).Z ⊤ = (E.ssData k).Z ↑(N - E.r₀).toNat

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:permanence-from-finite
blocks.title: From a finite page to infinity
blocks.body: Let $N\geq r_0$. If a label reaches page $N$ and $d_r$ is zero on its degree for every $r\geq N$, it is a permanent cycle. If it survives nontrivially to $N$ and the incoming differential morphisms are also zero for every $r\geq N$, it has nonzero survival at infinity.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.nonzeroSurvival_of_survivesTo
lean.code:
public theorem nonzeroSurvival_of_survivesTo
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (N : ℤ) (hN : E.r₀ ≤ N) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p)
    (hx : SurvivesTo E N p x)
    (hout : ∀ r : ℤ, N ≤ r → E.d r p = 0)
    (hin : ∀ r : ℤ, N ≤ r → E.d r (p - E.diffDeg r) = 0) :
    NonzeroSurvival E p x := by
  obtain ⟨xr, ⟨hN2, z, hz, hzr⟩, hne⟩ := hx
  let D := E.ssData p
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(N - E.r₀).toNat
  have hZ : D.Z ⊤ = D.Z n := cycles_top_eq_of_d_eq_zero E N hN p hout
  have hB : D.B ⊤ = D.B n := boundaries_top_eq_of_d_eq_zero E N hN p hin
  let zInf := (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z n) (D.Z ⊤) hZ.ge) z
  refine ⟨zInf, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (D.Z_anti le_top) ≫ D.pageπ _)
      ((Subobject.ofLE (D.Z n) (D.Z ⊤) hZ.ge) z) = x
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    exact hz
  · intro hzero
    apply hne
    rw [← hzr]
    apply (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D.B n) (D.Z n) (D.B_le_Z n) z).mpr
    have hb := (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D.B ⊤) (D.Z ⊤)
      (D.B_le_Z ⊤) zInf).mp hzero
    have heq : (D.Z ⊤).arrow zInf = (D.Z n).arrow z :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Subobject.ofLE_arrow hZ.ge) z
    rwa [heq, hB] at hb
lean.statement:
public theorem nonzeroSurvival_of_survivesTo
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ))
    (N : ℤ) (hN : E.r₀ ≤ N) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p)
    (hx : SurvivesTo E N p x)
    (hout : ∀ r : ℤ, N ≤ r → E.d r p = 0)
    (hin : ∀ r : ℤ, N ≤ r → E.d r (p - E.diffDeg r) = 0) :
    NonzeroSurvival E p x
lean.docstring:
Nonzero survival on a finite page persists at infinity when both later
outgoing and incoming differentials vanish at this grading.

    (N : ℤ) (hN : E.r₀ ≤ N) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page 2 p)

  let zInf := (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z n) (D.Z ⊤) hZ.ge) z

  change (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (D.Z_anti le_top) ≫ D.pageπ _)

  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]

comments.author: metadata-migration
comments.title: Interface scope: permanence-and-infinity-representatives
comments.text:
Scope of the related interface family `permanence-and-infinity-representatives`. This note does not assert equivalence with a broader paper statement or mark any proof complete.


- **mathematical_purpose**: Keep a named finite-page label tied to the same infinite-cycle representative and its actual E∞ image.

- **interface_role**: NonzeroSurvival and NextPageRelation are exact representative predicates; permanence and infinity uniqueness are proved operations.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: NonzeroSurvival requires a single z in Z∞ representing the named E₂ element whose E∞ image is nonzero. Independently chosen survivors on each page would be weaker and are not substituted.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: nonzeroSurvival_of_survivesTo keeps both incoming and outgoing tail-differential vanishing assumptions.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: infinity_projection_eq_of_page_projection_eq compares two Z∞ representatives through their equality on one finite quotient.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: NextPageRelation uses one successor-cycle representative for both quotient classes. It does not supply an unrestricted transition map on all page elements.

- **boundary**: No global proof of permanence or concrete Adams convergence is manufactured by the interface.

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:page-three
blocks.title: The third page as a differential quotient
blocks.body: Let $E$ be a module-valued spectral sequence with initial page $r_0\leq2$. A second-page class reaches $E_3$ if and only if it is a $d_2$ cycle. Two represented third-page classes agree if and only if their second-page difference lies in the image of the incoming $d_2$. A second-page label is a boundary by page two if and only if it lies in that image. Every third-page class has a second-page label.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.PageThree.isBoundaryBy_iff_mem_d2_range
lean.code:
public theorem isBoundaryBy_iff_mem_d2_range (hstart : E.r₀ ≤ 2) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (x : E.Page 2 (p + E.diffDeg 2)) :
    IsBoundaryBy E 2 (p + E.diffDeg 2) x ↔ x ∈ LinearMap.range (E.d 2 p).hom := by
  have hm : (2 + 1 - E.r₀).toNat = (2 - E.r₀).toNat + 1 := by omega
  have hb := congrArg (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (E.Page 2 (p + E.diffDeg 2)))
    (E.B_succ 2 p hstart)
  rw [subobjectModule_image, subobjectModule_image] at hb
  have hindexed (m : ℕ) (hnm : (2 - E.r₀).toNat ≤ m)
      (heq : m = (2 - E.r₀).toNat + 1) :
      LinearMap.range (E.d 2 p).hom = LinearMap.range
        (Subobject.ofLE ((E.ssData (p + E.diffDeg 2)).B ↑m)
          ((E.ssData (p + E.diffDeg 2)).Z ↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat)
          (((E.ssData (p + E.diffDeg 2)).B_le_Z ↑m).trans
            ((E.ssData (p + E.diffDeg 2)).Z_anti (by exact_mod_cast hnm))) ≫
          (E.ssData (p + E.diffDeg 2)).pageπ ↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat).hom := by
    subst m
    exact hb
  have hb := hindexed (2 + 1 - E.r₀).toNat (by omega) hm
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, b, hx⟩
    rw [hb]
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    simpa only [← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE] using hx
  · intro hx
    rw [hb] at hx
    obtain ⟨b, hx⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨by decide, b, by
      simpa only [← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE] using hx⟩
lean.docstring:
The cumulative boundary condition after d₂ is precisely the image of
that actual d₂. Indexing the target by `p + diffDeg 2` avoids choosing any
unrelated grading transport; as p varies this covers every target degree.

lean.code:
public theorem exists_representative (p : ℤ × ℤ) (y : E.Page 3 p) :
    ∃ x : E.Page 2 p, RepresentsOnPage E 3 p x y := by
  let D := E.ssData p
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat
  let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(3 - E.r₀).toNat
  let a := Subobject.ofLE (D.Z m) (D.Z n) (D.Z_anti (by
    dsimp only [n, m]
    exact_mod_cast (show (2 - E.r₀).toNat ≤ (3 - E.r₀).toNat by omega))) ≫ D.pageπ n
  letI : Epi (D.pageπ m) := coequalizer.π_epi
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (D.pageπ m)).mp inferInstance y
  exact ⟨a z, by decide, z, rfl, hz⟩

lean.code:
public theorem reachesPage_iff_d2_eq_zero (hstart : E.r₀ ≤ 2) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (x : E.Page 2 p) : ReachesPage E 3 p x ↔ E.d 2 p x = 0 := by
  have hm : (3 - E.r₀).toNat = (2 - E.r₀).toNat + 1 := by omega
  have hk := congrArg (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (E.Page 2 p)) (E.Z_succ 2 p hstart)
  rw [subobjectModule_kernel, subobjectModule_image] at hk
  have hindexed (m : ℕ) (hnm : (2 - E.r₀).toNat ≤ m)
      (heq : m = (2 - E.r₀).toNat + 1) :
      LinearMap.ker (E.d 2 p).hom = LinearMap.range
        (Subobject.ofLE ((E.ssData p).Z ↑m) ((E.ssData p).Z ↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat)
          ((E.ssData p).Z_anti (by exact_mod_cast hnm)) ≫
          (E.ssData p).pageπ ↑(2 - E.r₀).toNat).hom := by
    subst m
    exact hk
  have hk := hindexed (3 - E.r₀).toNat (by omega) hm
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, _, z, hx, _⟩
    have hmem : x ∈ LinearMap.ker (E.d 2 p).hom := by
      rw [hk]
      exact ⟨z, hx⟩
    exact hmem
  · intro hx
    have hmem : x ∈ LinearMap.ker (E.d 2 p).hom := hx
    rw [hk] at hmem
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hmem
    exact ⟨(E.ssData p).pageπ ↑(3 - E.r₀).toNat z, by decide, z, hz, rfl⟩

public theorem equal_iff_sub_mem_d2_range (hstart : E.r₀ ≤ 2) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    {a b : E.Page 2 (p + E.diffDeg 2)} {x y : E.Page 3 (p + E.diffDeg 2)}
    (ha : RepresentsOnPage E 3 (p + E.diffDeg 2) a x)
    (hb : RepresentsOnPage E 3 (p + E.diffDeg 2) b y) :
    x = y ↔ a - b ∈ LinearMap.range (E.d 2 p).hom := by
  calc
    x = y ↔ IsBoundaryBy E 2 (p + E.diffDeg 2) (a - b) := by
      have h : x - y = 0 ↔ IsBoundaryBy E 2 (p + E.diffDeg 2) (a - b) :=
        RepresentsOnPage.eq_zero_iff_isBoundaryBy (r := 2) (by decide)
          (represents_sub ha hb)
      exact (sub_eq_zero (a := x) (b := y)).symm.trans h
    _ ↔ a - b ∈ LinearMap.range (E.d 2 p).hom :=
      isBoundaryBy_iff_mem_d2_range hstart p (a - b)

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:representative-expansion
blocks.title: Calculating from complete representatives
blocks.body: Let $E$ be a spectral sequence of abelian groups, let $r\geq2$, and suppose $E_2^p\cong(\mathbb F_2)^N$ has basis $b_0,\ldots,b_{N-1}$. Suppose each $b_i$ represents $a_i\in E_r^p$. Then every page-$r$ class is a sum of a subfamily of the $a_i$. If $d_r(a_i)=0$ for every $i$, then $d_r=0$ in degree $p$. More generally, for a $\mathbb Z$-linear isomorphism $e:A\cong(\mathbb F_2)^N$, every $a\in A$ is the sum of the basis vectors whose coordinates under $e$ are nonzero.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FinitePageCalculus.page_eq_sum_of_complete_representatives
lean.code:
public theorem page_eq_sum_of_complete_representatives
    {ESeq : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)}
    {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} {n : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (e : ESeq.Page 2 p ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Fin n →₀ KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2))
    (xr : Fin n → ESeq.Page r p)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin n, RepresentsOnPage ESeq r p (e.symm (Finsupp.single i 1)) (xr i))
    (a : ESeq.Page r p) :
    ∃ c : Fin n → KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2, a = ∑ i, if c i = 0 then 0 else xr i := by
  classical
  have htwo (i : Fin n) : xr i + xr i = 0 := by
    have hh := represents_add_tail (hb i) (hb i)
    have he : e.symm (Finsupp.single i 1) + e.symm (Finsupp.single i 1) = 0 := by
      rw [← map_add, ← Finsupp.single_add]
      have h2 : (1 : KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)+1 = 0 := rfl
      rw [h2,Finsupp.single_zero,map_zero]
    rw [he] at hh
    exact represents_unique hh (RepresentsOnPage.zero hr)
  have hadd2 : (1 : KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)+1 = 0 := rfl
  let φ (i : Fin n) : KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2 →+ ESeq.Page r p :=
    { toFun := fun c => if c=0 then 0 else xr i
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := by
        intro a b
        fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [htwo,hadd2] }
  let Φ := Finsupp.liftAddHom φ
  have hrep (f : Fin n →₀ KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2) :
      RepresentsOnPage ESeq r p (e.symm f) (Φ f) := by
    induction f using Finsupp.induction with
    | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (RepresentsOnPage.zero (E := ESeq) (p := p) hr)
    | @single_add i a f hi ha ih =>
      fin_cases a
      · simpa using ih
      · rw [map_add,map_add]
        apply represents_add_tail _ ih
        simpa only [Φ,Finsupp.liftAddHom_apply_single,φ,AddMonoidHom.coe_mk,ZeroHom.coe_mk,
          show (⟨1,by decide⟩ : KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2) = 1 from rfl, one_ne_zero, ite_false] using hb i
  haveI : Epi ((ESeq.ssData p).pageπ ↑(r-ESeq.r₀).toNat) := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π _)
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective ((ESeq.ssData p).pageπ ↑(r-ESeq.r₀).toNat)).mp inferInstance a
  let x : ESeq.Page 2 p := (Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((ESeq.ssData p).Z_anti
    (by exact_mod_cast (show (2-ESeq.r₀).toNat ≤ (r-ESeq.r₀).toNat by omega))) ≫
    (ESeq.ssData p).pageπ ↑(2-ESeq.r₀).toNat) z
  have hx : RepresentsOnPage ESeq r p x a := ⟨hr,z,rfl,hz⟩
  have hy := hrep (e x)
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at hy
  refine ⟨e x, ?_⟩
  rw [represents_unique hx hy]
  change Finsupp.sum (e x) (fun i c => if c=0 then 0 else xr i) = _
  exact Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun _ => by simp)

lean.code:
public theorem d_zero_of_complete_representatives
    {ESeq : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)}
    {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} {n : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (e : ESeq.Page 2 p ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Fin n →₀ KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2))
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ xr : ESeq.Page r p,
      RepresentsOnPage ESeq r p (e.symm (Finsupp.single i 1)) xr ∧ ESeq.d r p xr = 0) :
    ESeq.d r p = 0 := by
  have hall (f : Fin n →₀ KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2) :
      ∃ xr : ESeq.Page r p, RepresentsOnPage ESeq r p (e.symm f) xr ∧ ESeq.d r p xr = 0 := by
    induction f using Finsupp.induction with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, (map_zero e.symm) ▸ RepresentsOnPage.zero hr, map_zero _⟩
    | @single_add i a f hi ha ih =>
      fin_cases a
      · simpa using ih
      · obtain ⟨xr,hxr,hdx⟩ := hb i
        obtain ⟨yr,hyr,hdy⟩ := ih
        exact ⟨xr+yr, (map_add e.symm _ _) ▸ represents_add_tail hxr hyr, by rw [map_add,hdx,hdy,zero_add]⟩
  ext yr
  haveI : Epi ((ESeq.ssData p).pageπ ↑(r-ESeq.r₀).toNat) := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π _)
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective ((ESeq.ssData p).pageπ ↑(r-ESeq.r₀).toNat)).mp inferInstance yr
  let x : ESeq.Page 2 p := (Subobject.ofLE _ _ ((ESeq.ssData p).Z_anti
    (by exact_mod_cast (show (2-ESeq.r₀).toNat ≤ (r-ESeq.r₀).toNat by omega))) ≫
    (ESeq.ssData p).pageπ ↑(2-ESeq.r₀).toNat) z
  have hrep : RepresentsOnPage ESeq r p x ((ESeq.ssData p).pageπ ↑(r-ESeq.r₀).toNat z) :=
    ⟨hr,z,rfl,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨xr,hxr,hdx⟩ := hall (e x)
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at hxr
  rw [represents_unique hrep hxr]
  exact hdx

public theorem finite_basis_expansion {A : Type v} [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℤ A] {N : ℕ}
    (e : A ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Fin N →₀ F2)) (a : A) :
    a=∑ i : Fin N, if (e a) i=0 then 0 else e.symm (Finsupp.single i 1) := by
  apply e.injective
  rw [map_sum]
  ext i
  simp only [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · generalize (e a) i=b
    fin_cases b <;> simp
  · intro j hj hji
    by_cases hc : (e a) j=0
    · simp [hc]
    · simp [hc,hji]
  · simp

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:successor-nonzero
blocks.title: Nonzero representatives on the successor page
blocks.body: Suppose the same label already has represented classes on page $r$ and on page $r+1$, with $r$ at least two and at least the initial page. The successor-page representative is nonzero if the page-$r$ representative is not an incoming differential target. It is also nonzero if the page-$r$ representative is nonzero and the relevant incoming morphism vanishes.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FinitePageCalculus.represents_next_nonzero_of_incoming_zero
lean.code:
public theorem represents_next_nonzero_of_incoming_zero
    {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)} {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hr0 : E.r₀ ≤ r) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hin : E.d r (p-E.diffDeg r) = 0)
    {x : E.Page 2 p} {a : E.Page (r+1) p} {b : E.Page r p}
    (ha : RepresentsOnPage E (r+1) p x a) (hb : RepresentsOnPage E r p x b)
    (hne : b ≠ 0) : a ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨_, z, hz, hza⟩ := ha
  let D := E.ssData p
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat
  let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r+1-E.r₀).toNat
  have hnm : n ≤ m := by
    dsimp only [n,m]
    exact_mod_cast (show (r-E.r₀).toNat ≤ (r+1-E.r₀).toNat by omega)
  have hB : D.B m = D.B n := by
    have hh := boundaries_succ_of_zero E r hr0 (p-E.diffDeg r) hin
    have hi : (r+1-E.r₀).toNat = (r-E.r₀).toNat+1 := by omega
    have hp : p-E.diffDeg r+E.diffDeg r = p := by abel
    rw [hp] at hh
    simpa only [D,n,m,hi] using hh
  let i := Subobject.ofLE (D.Z m) (D.Z n) (D.Z_anti hnm)
  have hb' : RepresentsOnPage E r p x (D.pageπ n (i z)) := by
    refine ⟨hr,i z,?_,rfl⟩
    change ((Subobject.ofLE _ _ (D.Z_anti hnm)) ≫
      Subobject.ofLE _ _ _ ≫ D.pageπ _) z = x
    rw [← Category.assoc,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
    exact hz
  intro ha0
  apply hne
  rw [represents_unique hb hb']
  apply (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D.B n) (D.Z n) (D.B_le_Z n) _).mpr
  have hm := (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (D.B m) (D.Z m) (D.B_le_Z m) z).mp (hza.trans ha0)
  rw [hB] at hm
  change (i ≫ (D.Z n).arrow) z ∈ _
  dsimp only [i]
  rwa [Subobject.ofLE_arrow]

lean.code:
public theorem represents_next_nonzero_of_not_incoming
    {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)}
    {r : ℤ} {q : ℤ × ℤ} (hr0 : E.r₀ ≤ r) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    {x : E.Page 2 (q+E.diffDeg r)} {a : E.Page (r+1) (q+E.diffDeg r)}
    {b : E.Page r (q+E.diffDeg r)}
    (ha : RepresentsOnPage E (r+1) (q+E.diffDeg r) x a)
    (hb : RepresentsOnPage E r (q+E.diffDeg r) x b)
    (havoid : ∀ v : E.Page r q, E.d r q v≠b) : a ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨_,z,hz,hza⟩ := ha
  let D := E.ssData (q+E.diffDeg r)
  let n : ℕ := (r-E.r₀).toNat
  let m : ℕ := (r+1-E.r₀).toNat
  have hnm : n ≤ m := by dsimp only [n,m]; omega
  let i := Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ↑m) (D.Z ↑n) (D.Z_anti (by exact_mod_cast hnm))
  have hb' : RepresentsOnPage E r (q+E.diffDeg r) x (D.pageπ ↑n (i z)) := by
    as_aux_lemma =>
      refine ⟨hr,i z,?_,rfl⟩
      change (i ≫ Subobject.ofLE _ _ _ ≫ D.pageπ _) z = x
      dsimp only [i]
      rw [←Category.assoc,Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
      exact hz
  have heq : D.pageπ ↑n (i z)=b := represents_unique hb' hb
  let P (k : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ (hk : n ≤ k)
      (w : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z ↑k) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
    D.pageπ ↑k w = 0 ↔
      (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z ↑k) (D.Z ↑n) (D.Z_anti (by exact_mod_cast hk)) ≫
        D.pageπ ↑n) w ∈ LinearMap.range (E.d r q).hom
  have hP : P (n+1) := by
    intro hk w
    exact next_projection_zero_iff_incoming E r hr0 q w
  have hi : m=n+1 := by dsimp only [m,n]; omega
  have hPm : P m := hi.symm ▸ hP
  intro ha0
  have hm := (hPm hnm z).mp (hza.trans ha0)
  change D.pageπ ↑n (i z) ∈ LinearMap.range (E.d r q).hom at hm
  rw [heq] at hm
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hm
  exact havoid v hv

lean.code:
public theorem choice_frame_of_three_basis
    {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ×ℤ)} {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ×ℤ}
    (hr : 2<r) (hr0 : E.r₀≤2)
    (e : E.Page 2 p ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Fin 3 →₀ KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2))
    (b0 b1 b2 : E.Page 2 p)
    (he0 : e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1)=b0)
    (he1 : e.symm (Finsupp.single 1 1)=b1)
    (he2 : e.symm (Finsupp.single 2 1)=b2)
    (a : E.Page r p) (ha : RepresentsOnPage E r p b1 a)
    (hz : RepresentsOnPage E r p b2 0)
    (hd0 : E.d 2 p b0≠0) : ∀ y:E.Page r p,y=0∨y=a := by
  classical
  have dz {x : E.Page 2 p} {b : E.Page r p}
      (hb : RepresentsOnPage E r p x b) : E.d 2 p x=0 := by
    obtain ⟨b2,hb2⟩ := reaches_before (by decide : (2:ℤ)≤2) (by omega : (2:ℤ)≤r) ⟨b,hb⟩
    have hh := represents_d_zero_of_later hr0 hr hb2 ⟨b,hb⟩
    simpa only [hb2.eq_on_page_two] using hh
  have hd1 := dz ha
  have hd2 := dz hz
  have hadd : RepresentsOnPage E r p (b1+b2) a := by
    obtain ⟨hr',z,hz',hza⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨_,w,hw,hwb⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨hr',z+w,by rw [map_add,hz',hw],?_⟩
    rw [map_add,hza,hwb,add_zero]
  intro y
  let A := E.ssData p
  let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2-E.r₀).toNat
  have hnm : n≤m := by
    dsimp only [n,m]
    exact_mod_cast (show (2-E.r₀).toNat≤(r-E.r₀).toNat by omega)
  haveI : Epi (A.pageπ m) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  obtain ⟨z,hy⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (A.pageπ m)).mp inferInstance y
  let x := (Subobject.ofLE (A.Z m) (A.Z n) (A.Z_anti hnm) ≫ A.pageπ n) z
  have hxrep : RepresentsOnPage E r p x y := ⟨by omega,z,rfl,hy⟩
  have hx : E.d 2 p x=0 := dz hxrep
  have heq : e x=Finsupp.single 0 (e x 0)+Finsupp.single 1 (e x 1)+Finsupp.single 2 (e x 2) := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  have hxe : x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (e x 0)+Finsupp.single 1 (e x 1)+Finsupp.single 2 (e x 2)) := by
    rw [←heq,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  generalize hc0 : e x 0=c0 at hxe
  generalize hc1 : e x 1=c1 at hxe
  generalize hc2 : e x 2=c2 at hxe
  fin_cases c0 <;> fin_cases c1 <;> fin_cases c2
  · change x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (0:KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)+Finsupp.single 1 (0:KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)+Finsupp.single 2 (0:KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)) at hxe
    simp only [Finsupp.single_zero,map_zero,add_zero] at hxe
    rw [hxe] at hx hxrep
    left
    apply represents_unique hxrep
    exact RepresentsOnPage.zero (by omega)
  · change x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (0:KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)+Finsupp.single 1 (0:KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)+Finsupp.single 2 (1:KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)) at hxe
    simp only [Finsupp.single_zero,zero_add,add_zero,he2] at hxe
    rw [hxe] at hx hxrep
    left
    apply represents_unique hxrep
    exact hz
  · change x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (0:KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)+Finsupp.single 1 (1:KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)+Finsupp.single 2 (0:KIP126.Core.Algebra.F2)) at hxe
    simp only [Finsupp.single_zero,zero_add,add_zero,he1] at hxe

public theorem fourth_frame_of_four_basis

    (e : E.Page 2 p ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Fin 4 →₀ F2))
    (f : E.Page 2 (p+E.diffDeg 2) ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Fin 2 →₀ F2))
    (a b c : E.Page 4 p)
    (ha : RepresentsOnPage E 4 p
      (e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1)+e.symm (Finsupp.single 1 1)) a)
    (hb : RepresentsOnPage E 4 p (e.symm (Finsupp.single 2 1)) b)
    (hc : RepresentsOnPage E 4 p (e.symm (Finsupp.single 3 1)) c)
    (d0 : E.d 2 p (e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1))=f.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1))
    (d1 : E.d 2 p (e.symm (Finsupp.single 1 1))=f.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1))
    (d2 : E.d 2 p (e.symm (Finsupp.single 2 1))=0)
    (d3 : E.d 2 p (e.symm (Finsupp.single 3 1))=0)
    (z : E.Page 4 p) :
    z=0 ∨ z=c ∨ z=b ∨ z=b+c ∨ z=a ∨ z=a+c ∨ z=a+b ∨ z=a+b+c := by
  classical
  let b0 := e.symm (Finsupp.single (0:Fin 4) 1)
  have he0 : e.symm (Finsupp.single (0:Fin 4) 1)=b0 := rfl
  let b1 := e.symm (Finsupp.single (1:Fin 4) 1)
  have he1 : e.symm (Finsupp.single (1:Fin 4) 1)=b1 := rfl
  let b2 := e.symm (Finsupp.single (2:Fin 4) 1)
  have he2 : e.symm (Finsupp.single (2:Fin 4) 1)=b2 := rfl
  let b3 := e.symm (Finsupp.single (3:Fin 4) 1)
  have he3 : e.symm (Finsupp.single (3:Fin 4) 1)=b3 := rfl
  change E.d 2 p b0=f.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1) at d0
  change E.d 2 p b1=f.symm (Finsupp.single 0 1) at d1
  change E.d 2 p b2=0 at d2
  change E.d 2 p b3=0 at d3
  have hf0 : f.symm (Finsupp.single (0:Fin 2) 1)=f.symm (Finsupp.single (0:Fin 2) 1) := rfl

  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := page_has_representative (by decide : (2:ℤ)≤4) z
  have dx : E.d 2 p x=0 :=
    represents_d_zero_of_later (by omega) (by decide : (2:ℤ)<4) (represents_two_self x) ⟨z,hx⟩
  have hex : e x=Finsupp.single 0 (e x 0)+Finsupp.single 1 (e x 1)+Finsupp.single 2 (e x 2)+Finsupp.single 3 (e x 3) := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  have hxe : x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (e x 0)+Finsupp.single 1 (e x 1)+Finsupp.single 2 (e x 2)+Finsupp.single 3 (e x 3)) := by rw [←hex,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  generalize h0 : e x 0=c0 at hxe
  generalize h1 : e x 1=c1 at hxe
  generalize h2 : e x 2=c2 at hxe
  generalize h3 : e x 3=c3 at hxe
  fin_cases c0 <;> fin_cases c1 <;> fin_cases c2 <;> fin_cases c3
  · change x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 1 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 2 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 3 (0:F2)) at hxe
    simp only [Finsupp.single_zero,add_zero,map_zero] at hxe
    exact Or.inl (represents_unique (by simpa only [hxe] using hx) (RepresentsOnPage.zero (by decide)))
  · change x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 1 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 2 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 3 (1:F2)) at hxe
    simp only [Finsupp.single_zero,zero_add,add_zero] at hxe
    rw [he3] at hxe
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl (represents_unique (by simpa only [hxe] using hx) (hc)))
  · change x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 1 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 2 (1:F2) + Finsupp.single 3 (0:F2)) at hxe
    simp only [Finsupp.single_zero,zero_add,add_zero] at hxe
    rw [he2] at hxe
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (represents_unique (by simpa only [hxe] using hx) (hb))))
  · change x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 1 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 2 (1:F2) + Finsupp.single 3 (1:F2)) at hxe
    simp only [Finsupp.single_zero,zero_add,add_zero,map_add] at hxe
    rw [he2] at hxe
    rw [he3] at hxe
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (represents_unique (by simpa only [hxe] using hx) (represents_add_tail (hb) hc)))))
  · change x=e.symm (Finsupp.single 0 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 1 (1:F2) + Finsupp.single 2 (0:F2) + Finsupp.single 3 (0:F2)) at hxe

    {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)}
    {r : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} (hr : E.r₀ ≤ r)
    (hker : ∀ x : E.Page r p, E.d r p x = 0 → x = 0) :
    Subsingleton (E.Page (r+1) p) := by
  let S := E.pageShortComplex r (p-E.diffDeg r)
  have kerS : ∀ x : S.X₂, S.g x = 0 → x = 0 := by
    change ∀ x : E.Page r (p-E.diffDeg r+E.diffDeg r),
      E.d r (p-E.diffDeg r+E.diffDeg r) x = 0 → x = 0
    rw [sub_add_cancel]
    exact hker
  have hs : S.Exact := S.moduleCat_exact_iff.mpr (by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨0,by rw [kerS x hx,map_zero]⟩)
  exact ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero ((pageHomologyIso E r p hr).isZero_iff.mpr
    ((S.exact_iff_isZero_homology).mp hs))

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:finite-hit
blocks.title: A differential target becomes zero later
blocks.body: Suppose $r\geq r_0$ and $d_r(x)=y$ between represented second-page labels in degrees $p$ and $q=p+\deg(d_r)$. The represented page-$r$ target is a cycle. For every $t>r$, the label $y$ represents zero on page $t$.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FinitePageCalculus.differential_target_later_zero
lean.code:
public theorem differential_target_later_zero
    {E : KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ) (ℤ × ℤ)} {r t : ℤ} {p q : ℤ × ℤ} {x : E.Page 2 p} {y : E.Page 2 q}
    (hr0 : E.r₀ ≤ r) (hrt : r < t)
    (h : HasDifferential E r p q x y) : RepresentsOnPage E t q y 0 := by
  obtain ⟨rfl, xr, yr, hx, hy, hd⟩ := h
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id] at hd
  obtain ⟨hr, z, hz2, hzr⟩ := hy
  let A := E.ssData (p + E.diffDeg r)
  let n : ℕ := (r-E.r₀).toNat
  let n₀ : WithTop ℕ := ↑(2-E.r₀).toNat
  let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(t-E.r₀).toNat
  have hnm : (↑(n+1) : WithTop ℕ) ≤ m := by
    dsimp only [n,m]
    exact_mod_cast (show (r-E.r₀).toNat+1 ≤ (t-E.r₀).toNat by omega)
  have hn0 : n₀ ≤ ↑n := by
    dsimp only [n₀,n]
    exact_mod_cast (show (2-E.r₀).toNat ≤ (r-E.r₀).toNat by omega)
  have hn1 : (↑n : WithTop ℕ) ≤ ↑(n+1) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n
  have hdmem : yr ∈ LinearMap.range (E.d r p).hom := ⟨xr, hd⟩
  rw [← subobjectModule_image, E.B_succ r p hr0, subobjectModule_image] at hdmem
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hdmem
  let j := Subobject.ofLE (A.B ↑(n+1)) (A.Z ↑n)
    ((A.B_le_Z _).trans (A.Z_anti hn1))
  have hb' : A.pageπ ↑n (j b) = yr := hb
  have hdif : A.pageπ ↑n (z-j b) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, hzr, hb', sub_self]
  have hmem := (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (A.B ↑n) (A.Z ↑n) (A.B_le_Z _) _).mp hdif
  have hmem' := (ModuleCat.subobjectModule A.V).monotone (A.B_mono hn1) hmem
  have hj : (A.Z ↑n).arrow (j b) ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule A.V) (A.B ↑(n+1)) := by
    change (j ≫ (A.Z ↑n).arrow) b ∈ _
    dsimp only [j]
    rw [Subobject.ofLE_arrow]
    exact ⟨b,rfl⟩
  have hzmem := ((ModuleCat.subobjectModule A.V) (A.B ↑(n+1))).add_mem hmem' hj
  rw [map_sub, sub_add_cancel] at hzmem
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hzmem
  let i := Subobject.ofLE (A.B ↑(n+1)) (A.Z m) ((A.B_mono hnm).trans (A.B_le_Z _))
  refine ⟨by omega, i b', ?_, ?_⟩
  · have he : (Subobject.ofLE (A.Z m) (A.Z n₀) (A.Z_anti (hn0.trans (hn1.trans hnm))))
        (i b') = (Subobject.ofLE (A.Z ↑n) (A.Z n₀) (A.Z_anti hn0)) z := by
      apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (A.Z n₀).arrow).mp inferInstance
      change (i ≫ Subobject.ofLE (A.Z m) (A.Z n₀) _ ≫ (A.Z n₀).arrow) b' =
        (Subobject.ofLE (A.Z ↑n) (A.Z n₀) _ ≫ (A.Z n₀).arrow) z
      simpa only [Category.assoc, i, Subobject.ofLE_arrow] using hb'
    exact (congrArg (fun v => A.pageπ n₀ v) he).trans hz2
  · apply (subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (A.B m) (A.Z m) (A.B_le_Z _) _).mpr
    change (i ≫ (A.Z m).arrow) b' ∈ _
    dsimp only [i]
    rw [Subobject.ofLE_arrow]
    exact (ModuleCat.subobjectModule A.V).monotone (A.B_mono hnm) ⟨b',rfl⟩

    (hr0 : E.r₀ ≤ r) (hrt : r < t)
    (h : HasDifferential E r p q x y) : RepresentsOnPage E t q y 0

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:filtration
blocks.title: A decreasing filtration and its associated graded
blocks.body: A filtration consists of decreasing subobjects $F^s A^k$. Its associated graded is the cokernel of $F^{s+1}A^k\longrightarrow F^sA^k$, with its canonical quotient map. Filtration-preserving maps induce the corresponding maps on associated graded objects.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMorphism
lean.code:
public structure FilteredMorphism
    {ω : Type w} {A₁ A₂ : ω → C} (F₁ : Filtration A₁) (F₂ : Filtration A₂) where
  /-- Degreewise map. -/
  map : ∀ (k : ω), A₁ k ⟶ A₂ k
  /-- Restriction to every filtration level. -/
  compat : ∀ (s : ℤ) (k : ω),
    ∃ (φ : Subobject.underlying.obj (F₁.F s k) ⟶
      Subobject.underlying.obj (F₂.F s k)),
      φ ≫ (F₂.F s k).arrow = (F₁.F s k).arrow ≫ map k

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:bounded
blocks.title: Boundedness, exhaustion, and separation
blocks.body: A bounded filtration has explicit lower and upper bounds in each degree. Lower boundedness implies exhaustion, and upper boundedness implies the Hausdorff property, for the same filtration.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.Filtration.IsHausdorff
lean.code:
public def Filtration.IsHausdorff
    {ω : Type w} {A : ω → C} (F : Filtration A) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : ω) (S : Subobject (A k)), (∀ s : ℤ, S ≤ F.F s k) → S = ⊥
lean.statement:
public def Filtration.IsHausdorff
    {ω : Type w} {A : ω → C} (F : Filtration A) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : ω) (S : Subobject (A k)), (∀ s : ℤ, S ≤ F.F s k) → S = ⊥
lean.docstring:
Degreewise Hausdorffness: the intersection of the filtration levels is
zero, expressed by its subobject universal property. No finite level is
required to vanish.

  intro k
  exact ⟨h.hi k, h.boundedAbove k (h.hi k) le_rfl⟩

/-- Extensionality for convergence morphisms. -/
@[ext]

comments.title: Interface scope: convergence-and-detection
comments.text:
Scope of the related interface family `convergence-and-detection`. This note does not assert equivalence with a broader paper statement or mark any proof complete.


- **mathematical_purpose**: Relate the actual E∞ of a supplied sequence to associated grades of a specified filtration, with natural maps and detection.

- **interface_role**: Filtration and Convergence are given structures. Detection, quotient zero tests and finite-gap consequences are defined or proved from them.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Convergence contains an actual reindexing and E∞ ≅ associatedGraded; it does not silently assert boundedness, Hausdorffness, exhaustiveness or existence of a concrete model.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: ConvergenceMorphism ties the abutment map, its filtration compatibility and E∞ map by the actual associated-graded square.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: detect_zero and the ModuleCat quotient-zero criterion yield an actual lift or membership in the next filtration level.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Finite interval grade vanishing gives equality of its filtration endpoints without an infinite-tail separation assumption.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Degreewise upper/lower bounds remain explicit data; IsHausdorff is the intersection-zero universal property, not finite-stage vanishing.

- **boundary**: Concrete tower convergence and any infinite-tail separation theorem remain producer obligations; the generic library does not insert them as axioms.

- **boundary**: Filtration has one public definition in Internal/Algebra/Filtration/Data.lean. Filtered complexes, convergence, completion and truncation use this same type; the former Algebra.Filtration record and bidirectional conversion wrappers are removed.

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:completion
blocks.title: The quotient tower of a filtration
blocks.body: The quotients $A^k/F^sA^k$, their transition morphisms, and the canonical cone form the quotient tower. A completion witness identifies the original object with the limit of this specified tower.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.Filtration.quotientTowerCone
lean.code:
public noncomputable def quotientTowerCone (F : Filtration A) (i : ι) :
    Cone (F.quotientTower i) where
  pt := A i
  π :=
    { app := fun s => F.quotientProjection s i
      naturality := by
        intro s t f
        dsimp [quotientTower]
        calc
          𝟙 (A i) ≫ F.quotientProjection t i = F.quotientProjection t i := Category.id_comp _
          _ = F.quotientProjection s i ≫ F.quotientTransition f.le i :=
            (F.quotientProjection_transition f.le i).symm }

public noncomputable def quotientTransition (F : Filtration A) {t s : ℤ} (h : t ≤ s) (i : ι) :

    change (F.F s i).arrow ≫ cokernel.π (F.F t i).arrow = 0
    rw [← F.inclusion_arrow h i, Category.assoc, cokernel.condition, comp_zero])

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:detection
blocks.title: Detection in an associated graded quotient
blocks.body: An infinity-page class detects a filtered representative when its convergence image equals the associated graded quotient of that representative. A convergence morphism preserves the filtered target and commutes with these specified infinity-page identifications.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.ConvergenceMorphism
lean.code:
public structure ConvergenceMorphism
    {ω : Type w} [AddCommGroup ω] [DecidableEq ω]
    {E₁ E₂ : SpectralSequence C ω} {ω' : Type w}
    {A₁ A₂ : ω' → C} {F₁ : Filtration A₁} {F₂ : Filtration A₂}
    (conv₁ : Convergence E₁ A₁ F₁) (conv₂ : Convergence E₂ A₂ F₂)
    extends ConvergenceMorphismData conv₁ conv₂ where
  /-- The two reindexings agree. -/
  reindex_eq : conv₁.reindex = conv₂.reindex
  /-- Compatibility with the convergence isomorphisms. -/
  iso_compat : ∀ (k : ω),
    eMap k ≫ (conv₂.iso k).hom ≫
      F₂.transportGraded (congrFun reindex_eq k).symm =
    (conv₁.iso k).hom ≫
      Filtration.inducedAssocGradedMap aMap filtration_compat
        (conv₁.reindex k).1 (conv₁.reindex k).2

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:detected-difference
blocks.title: Differences of detected representatives
blocks.body: Let $T$ be an object of the abelian category, and let $x,x' : T\to F^sA^k$ be filtered representatives. If $y:T\to E_\infty^p$ detects both, where $p$ reindexes to $(s,k)$, then $x-x'$ factors through $F^{s+1}A^k$. Conversely, if $y$ detects $x$ and this factorization exists, then $y$ detects $x'$. The zero infinity-page class detects $x$ if and only if $x$ factors through $F^{s+1}A^k$. For module-valued filtrations, a filtered element has zero associated graded image if and only if its ambient image belongs to $F^{s+1}A^k$.

    {R : Type u} [Ring R] {ω : Type w} {A : ω → ModuleCat.{v} R}

    (x : (Subobject.underlying.obj (F.F s k) : ModuleCat R)) :
    F.toAssociatedGraded s k x = 0 ↔
      (F.F s k).arrow x ∈ (ModuleCat.subobjectModule (A k)) (F.F (s + 1) k) :=
  subobject_cokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (F.F (s + 1) k) (F.F s k) (F.mono s k) x

public theorem detect_difference
    {ω : Type w} [AddCommGroup ω] [DecidableEq ω]
    {E : SpectralSequence C ω} {ω' : Type w} {A : ω' → C} {F : Filtration A}
    (conv : Convergence E A F)
    {T : C} {k : ω}
    (y : T ⟶ (E.ssData k).eInfty)
    (x x' : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj
      (F.F (conv.reindex k).1 (conv.reindex k).2)) :
    (Detects conv y x ∧ Detects conv y x') ↔
      (Detects conv y x ∧
        ∃ (z : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj
          (F.F ((conv.reindex k).1 + 1) (conv.reindex k).2)),
          z ≫ Subobject.ofLE
            (F.F ((conv.reindex k).1 + 1) (conv.reindex k).2)
            (F.F (conv.reindex k).1 (conv.reindex k).2)
            (F.mono (conv.reindex k).1 (conv.reindex k).2) = x - x') := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hx'⟩
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    have key : (x - x') ≫
        F.toAssociatedGraded (conv.reindex k).1 (conv.reindex k).2 = 0 := by
      rw [Detects] at hx hx'
      rw [Preadditive.sub_comp, sub_eq_zero]
      exact hx.symm.trans hx'
    simp only [Filtration.toAssociatedGraded] at key
    exact ⟨Abelian.monoLift _ (x - x') key,
      Abelian.monoLift_comp _ (x - x') key⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, z, hz⟩
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    change y ≫ (conv.iso k).hom =
      x' ≫ F.toAssociatedGraded (conv.reindex k).1 (conv.reindex k).2
    have hd : Detects conv y x := hx
    rw [Detects] at hd
    have hx'eq : x' = x - z ≫ Subobject.ofLE
        (F.F ((conv.reindex k).1 + 1) (conv.reindex k).2)
        (F.F (conv.reindex k).1 (conv.reindex k).2)
        (F.mono (conv.reindex k).1 (conv.reindex k).2) := by
      rw [hz, sub_sub_cancel]
    have hz0 : (z ≫ Subobject.ofLE
        (F.F ((conv.reindex k).1 + 1) (conv.reindex k).2)
        (F.F (conv.reindex k).1 (conv.reindex k).2)
        (F.mono (conv.reindex k).1 (conv.reindex k).2)) ≫
        F.toAssociatedGraded (conv.reindex k).1 (conv.reindex k).2 = 0 := by
      dsimp only [Filtration.toAssociatedGraded, Filtration.associatedGraded]
      rw [Category.assoc, cokernel.condition, comp_zero]
      rfl
    rw [hx'eq, Preadditive.sub_comp, hd, hz0, sub_zero]

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:graded-vanishing
blocks.title: Vanishing associated graded pieces
blocks.body: A zero associated graded piece makes two successive filtration subobjects equal. If all associated graded pieces in a specified interval vanish, the filtration levels at its endpoints agree.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.Filtration.eq_of_associatedGraded_isZero
lean.code:
public theorem Filtration.eq_of_associatedGraded_isZero (s t : ℤ) (k : ω)
    (hst : s ≤ t)
    (h : ∀ j : ℤ, s ≤ j → j < t → IsZero (F.associatedGraded j k)) :
    F.F s k = F.F t k := by
  have step : ∀ n : ℕ, s + n ≤ t → F.F s k = F.F (s + n) k := by
    intro n hn
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [show s + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (s + n) + 1 by omega]
      exact (ih (by omega)).trans
        (F.eq_succ_of_associatedGraded_isZero _ k (h _ (by omega) (by omega)))
  simpa only [show s + ((t - s).toNat : ℤ) = t by omega] using
    step (t - s).toNat (by omega)
lean.statement:
public theorem Filtration.eq_of_associatedGraded_isZero (s t : ℤ) (k : ω)
    (hst : s ≤ t)
    (h : ∀ j : ℤ, s ≤ j → j < t → IsZero (F.associatedGraded j k)) :
    F.F s k = F.F t k

Vanishing on a finite interval identifies its endpoint filtrations.
No separation or convergence hypothesis is required.

public theorem Filtration.eq_succ_of_associatedGraded_isZero (s : ℤ) (k : ω)
    (h : IsZero (F.associatedGraded s k)) : F.F s k = F.F (s + 1) k := by
  let i := Subobject.ofLE (F.F (s + 1) k) (F.F s k) (F.mono s k)

  · apply Subobject.le_of_comm (inv i)
    rw [← Subobject.ofLE_arrow (F.mono s k)]
    exact IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc i _
  · exact F.mono s k

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:differential-coset
blocks.title: The complete differential target coset
blocks.body: Once a differential relation from $x$ to $y$ is known, another target $z$ satisfies the same relation exactly when it lies in the complete target coset of $y$. Essentiality is equivalently the exclusion of zero from the target coset.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.DifferentialRelation.targets_sub_factors_boundary
lean.code:
public theorem DifferentialRelation.targets_sub_factors_boundary
    (E : SpectralSequence C ι) (r : ℤ) (k : ι) {T : C}
    {x : T ⟶ (E.ssData k).V}
    {y₁ y₂ : T ⟶ (E.ssData (k + E.diffDeg r)).V}
    (h₁ : DifferentialRelation E r k x y₁)
    (h₂ : DifferentialRelation E r k x y₂) :
    Subobject.Factors
      ((E.ssData (k + E.diffDeg r)).B (↑(r - E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ))
      (y₁ - y₂) := by
  rcases h₁ with ⟨xZ₁, hx₁, yZ₁, hy₁, hrel₁⟩
  rcases h₂ with ⟨xZ₂, hx₂, yZ₂, hy₂, hrel₂⟩
  have heq : xZ₁ = xZ₂ := by
    apply (cancel_mono ((E.ssData k).Z (↑(r - E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ)).arrow).mp
    exact hx₁.trans hx₂.symm
  subst xZ₂
  have hpage : yZ₁ ≫
      (E.ssData (k + E.diffDeg r)).pageπ (↑(r - E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ) =
      yZ₂ ≫
      (E.ssData (k + E.diffDeg r)).pageπ (↑(r - E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ) :=
    hrel₁.symm.trans hrel₂
  simpa only [hy₁, hy₂] using
    (E.ssData (k + E.diffDeg r)).sub_factors_boundary_of_page_eq
      (↑(r - E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ) yZ₁ yZ₂ hpage

public theorem DifferentialRelation.mem_targetCoset_iff
    (E : SpectralSequence C ι) (r : ℤ) (k : ι) {T : C}
    {x : T ⟶ (E.ssData k).V}
    {y z : T ⟶ (E.ssData (k + E.diffDeg r)).V}
    (h : DifferentialRelation E r k x y) :
    z ∈ DifferentialTargetCoset E r k y ↔ DifferentialRelation E r k x z := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rcases h with ⟨xZ, hx, yZ, hy, hrel⟩
    let D := E.ssData (k + E.diffDeg r)
    let q : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r - E.r₀).toNat
    let i := Subobject.ofLE (D.B q) (D.Z q) (D.B_le_Z q)
    let b := (D.B q).factorThru (y - z) hz
    have hb : b ≫ (D.B q).arrow = y - z := Subobject.factorThru_arrow _ _ hz
    refine ⟨xZ, hx, yZ - b ≫ i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_arrow, hy, hb]
      abel
    · change xZ ≫ (E.ssData k).pageπ q ≫ E.d r k =
        (yZ - b ≫ i) ≫ cokernel.π i
      rw [Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.assoc, cokernel.condition, comp_zero, sub_zero]
      exact hrel
  · exact DifferentialRelation.targets_sub_factors_boundary E r k h

comments.text:
Scope of the related interface family `ambient-differential-relations`. This note does not assert equivalence with a broader paper statement or mark any proof complete.


- **mathematical_purpose**: Describe the actual differential using ambient representatives and identify its complete target boundary coset.

- **interface_role**: Generic categorical representative relations and proved coset operations, usable by bounded ESS consumers.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: DifferentialRelation supplies actual cycle lifts of both ambient labels whose quotient images satisfy the actual differential equation.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: DifferentialTargetCoset is the full translate by the actual target Bᵣ subobject. Given one relation, membership is equivalent to another relation with the same source.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: EssentialDifferentialRelation means the target does not factor through that boundary; the proved criterion excludes zero from the full target coset.

- **boundary**: The broader private crossing predicates are not exported as replacements for Adams page-extension crossing: their quantifiers and exact filtration constraints differ.

- **boundary**: The generic relation is not an arbitrary user-supplied Prop field and does not discard the actual spectral-sequence differential.

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:extension-equation
blocks.title: Extensions of one specified filtered map
blocks.body: Let $f:A\to B$ preserve filtrations $F,G$, and let $T$ be an object of the abelian category. A length-$n$ extension from $x:T\to\operatorname{gr}^s A$ to $y:T\to\operatorname{gr}^{s+n}B$ consists of $n\geq0$ and lifts $a:T\to F^sA$, $b:T\to G^{s+n}B$ with associated graded images $x,y$ such that $f\circ i_F\circ a=i_G\circ b$, where $i_F,i_G$ are the ambient inclusions.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapExtension.Relation
lean.code:
public def Relation (f : FilteredMorphism F G) (k : ω) (s n : ℤ)
    {T : C} (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k)
    (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s + n) k) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ n ∧ ∃ (a : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (F.F s k))
    (b : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (G.F (s + n) k)),
    a ≫ F.toAssociatedGraded s k = x ∧
    b ≫ G.toAssociatedGraded (s + n) k = y ∧
    a ≫ (F.F s k).arrow ≫ f.map k = b ≫ (G.F (s + n) k).arrow

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:extension-coset
blocks.title: All targets of the same extension source
blocks.body: Extension relations are closed under addition and subtraction. For a known extension from $x$ to $y$, the full coset of $y$ consists exactly of all targets of $x$. Such an extension is essential exactly when $x$ has no zero target.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapExtension.Relation.mem_targetCoset_iff
lean.code:
public theorem Relation.mem_targetCoset_iff (h : Relation f k s n x y) :
    z ∈ TargetCoset f k s n y ↔ Relation f k s n x z := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hh : Relation f k s n 0 (z - y) := hz
    simpa only [zero_add, sub_add_cancel] using hh.add h
  · intro hz
    change Relation f k s n 0 (z - y)
    simpa only [sub_self] using hz.sub h
lean.statement:
public theorem Relation.mem_targetCoset_iff (h : Relation f k s n x y) :
    z ∈ TargetCoset f k s n y ↔ Relation f k s n x z
lean.docstring: Once a target is known, its coset consists exactly of all targets of the same source.

comments.author: metadata-migration
comments.title: Interface scope: filtered-map-extensions
comments.text:
Scope of the related interface family `filtered-map-extensions`. This note does not assert equivalence with a broader paper statement or mark any proof complete.


- **mathematical_purpose**: Use extension equations, actual lifts, complete target indeterminacy and essentiality for one specified filtered map.

- **interface_role**: New public consumer wrapper over existing mathematical semantics, with all operation laws proved. ConvergenceMorphism.filteredMap extracts the same abutment map and compatibility witness.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Relation f k s n x y requires 0 ≤ n and actual a in Fˢ, b in Gˢ⁺ⁿ with the specified quotient labels and the exact equation a ≫ inclusion ≫ f.map = b ≫ inclusion.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: TargetIndeterminacy consists exactly of homogeneous Relation f ... 0 z solutions. mem_indeterminacy_iff identifies it with actual source lifts in Fˢ⁺¹ mapped into Gˢ⁺ⁿ by the same f.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Given one solution, TargetCoset is the entire set of possible targets for that source, not a chosen subspace of ambiguity.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Essential excludes zero from that full target coset and is equivalent to the absence of a zero-target relation.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: For arbitrary probe T, a zero-length relation is equivalent to both source quotient-lift existence and the induced associated-graded map equation.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Only with Projective T can source lift existence be discharged and the zero-length criterion reduce to the graded equation.

- **boundary**: No new property field claims these consequences without proof; the generic operations are theorems.

- **boundary**: The wrapper is independent of concrete filtered-complex construction while its bridge proves equivalence to the original solution fiber.

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:higher-filtration
blocks.title: Indeterminacy from higher source filtration
blocks.body: For a test object $T$, a morphism $y:T\to\operatorname{gr}^{s+n}B$ belongs to the target indeterminacy if and only if $n\geq0$ and there are lifts $a:T\to F^{s+1}A$ and $b:T\to G^{s+n}B$ such that $f\circ i_F\circ a=i_G\circ b$ and $b$ has associated graded image $y$.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapExtension.mem_indeterminacy_iff
lean.code:
public theorem mem_indeterminacy_iff :
    z ∈ TargetIndeterminacy f k s n T ↔
      0 ≤ n ∧ ∃ (a : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (F.F (s + 1) k))
        (b : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (G.F (s + n) k)),
        b ≫ G.toAssociatedGraded (s + n) k = z ∧
        a ≫ (F.F (s + 1) k).arrow ≫ f.map k =
          b ≫ (G.F (s + n) k).arrow := by
  let i := Subobject.ofLE (F.F (s + 1) k) (F.F s k) (F.mono s k)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hn, a, b, ha, hb, he⟩
    have ha0 : a ≫ cokernel.π i = 0 := ha
    let a' := Abelian.monoLift i a ha0
    have ha' : a' ≫ i = a := Abelian.monoLift_comp i a ha0
    refine ⟨hn, a', b, hb, ?_⟩
    rw [← ha'] at he
    simpa only [Category.assoc, i, Subobject.ofLE_arrow_assoc] using he
  · rintro ⟨hn, a, b, hb, he⟩
    refine ⟨hn, a ≫ i, b, ?_, hb, ?_⟩
    · change (a ≫ i) ≫ cokernel.π i = 0
      rw [Category.assoc, cokernel.condition, comp_zero]
    · simpa only [Category.assoc, i, Subobject.ofLE_arrow_assoc] using he

        (b : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (G.F (s + n) k)),

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:length-zero
blocks.title: Length-zero extensions
blocks.body: At length zero, the extension relation is the equation for the induced associated graded map together with existence of a source lift. When the test object is projective, that lifting condition follows from the quotient epimorphism.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapExtension.relation_zero_iff_of_projective
lean.code:
public theorem relation_zero_iff_of_projective (f : FilteredMorphism F G)
    (k : ω) (s : ℤ) {T : C} [Projective T]
    (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k)
    (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s + 0) k) :
    Relation f k s 0 x y ↔
      x ≫ f.inducedGrMap s k = y ≫ G.transportGraded (show (s + 0, k) = (s, k) by simp) := by
  rw [relation_zero_iff]
  haveI : Epi (F.toAssociatedGraded s k) := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π _))
  exact and_iff_right ⟨Projective.factorThru x (F.toAssociatedGraded s k),
    Projective.factorThru_comp x (F.toAssociatedGraded s k)⟩

comments.title: Interface scope: bounded-extension-sequence
comments.text:
Scope of the related interface family `bounded-extension-sequence`. This note does not assert equivalence with a broader paper statement or mark any proof complete.


- **mathematical_purpose**: Obtain the extension spectral sequence of the same bounded filtered map and connect its actual differentials to the extension equation.

- **interface_role**: A small opaque public construction and proved comparison interface around the private filtered complex.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: Both source and target degreewise boundedness witnesses are explicit and belong to the very same filtrations as f.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: The supplied sequence starts at zero and has differential degree (n,-1). sourceIso and targetIso identify its actual ambient objects with the source/target associated grades.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: For n : ℕ and Projective T, differentialRelation_iff equates the actual differential relation of this sequence with Relation f, after the specified isomorphisms.

- **mathematical_strength_preserved**: The bridge is proved via the original FilteredComplex.Solutions.Fiber equivalence, retaining its actual-lift semantics and projectivity condition.

- **boundary**: No unbounded ESS construction is asserted. General extension relations remain usable without boundedness.

- **boundary**: No direct current AdamsSynthetic use of sequence is claimed: that module consumes the general extension equation; the bounded ESS bridge is exercised by the ordinary-import SpectralSequence consumer test.

- **boundary**: FilteredComplex, underlyingComplex, solution-fiber implementation and their construction proofs remain private.

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:ess-equation
blocks.title: ESS differentials are extension equations
blocks.body: For bounded source and target filtrations, a nonnegative length $n$, and a projective test object, the actual differential relation in the bounded extension spectral sequence is equivalent to the representative extension equation for the original filtered map.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapExtension.differentialRelation_iff
lean.code:
public theorem differentialRelation_iff (f : FilteredMorphism F G)
    (hF : F.IsBounded) (hG : G.IsBounded) (k : ω) (s : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    {T : C} [Projective T] (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k)
    (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s + (n : ℤ)) k) :
    DifferentialRelation (sequence f hF hG k) n (s, 1)
      (x ≫ (sourceIso f hF hG k s).inv)
      (y ≫ (targetIso f hF hG k s n).inv) ↔ Relation f k s n x y := by
  rw [relation_iff_fiber, and_iff_right (Int.natCast_nonneg n)]
  change DifferentialRelation
    ((underlyingComplex f.map f.compat k).toSpectralSequence
      (underlyingComplexBounded f.map f.compat k hF hG)) n (s, 1)
    (x ≫ 𝟙 (F.associatedGraded s k)) (y ≫ 𝟙 (G.associatedGraded (s + ↑n) k)) ↔ _
  rw [Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id]
  exact
    FilteredComplex.Solutions.differentialRelation_iff_nonempty_fiber
      (underlyingComplex f.map f.compat k)
      (underlyingComplexBounded f.map f.compat k hF hG) n s 1 x y
lean.statement:
public theorem differentialRelation_iff (f : FilteredMorphism F G)
    (hF : F.IsBounded) (hG : G.IsBounded) (k : ω) (s : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    {T : C} [Projective T] (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k)
    (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s + (n : ℤ)) k) :
    DifferentialRelation (sequence f hF hG k) n (s, 1)
      (x ≫ (sourceIso f hF hG k s).inv)
      (y ≫ (targetIso f hF hG k s n).inv) ↔ Relation f k s n x y

The actual ESS differential relation is precisely the original filtered-map
equation. Projectivity is retained when arbitrary morphism-valued labels are used.
