blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:extension-transport
blocks.title: Transport preserves extensions and their full ambiguity
blocks.body: Levelwise filtered transport preserves representative equations, extension relations, complete target indeterminacy, target cosets, and essentiality. These representative-level statements do not require bounded filtrations.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapTransport.representative_equation_iff
lean.code:
public theorem representative_equation_iff
    (a : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (F.F s k))
    (b : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (G.F (s+n) k)) :
    a ≫ (F.F s k).arrow ≫ f.map k = b ≫ (G.F (s+n) k).arrow ↔
      (a ≫ (e.source.level s).hom) ≫ (F'.F s k').arrow ≫ f'.map k' =
        (b ≫ (e.target.level (s+n)).hom) ≫ (G'.F (s+n) k').arrow := by
  have hsource := e.source.level_arrow s
  have htarget := e.target.level_arrow (s+n)
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (e.source.level s).hom, hsource, Category.assoc, e.map_comm]
  rw [htarget]
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun z => z ≫ e.target.ambient.hom) h
  · intro h
    apply (cancel_mono e.target.ambient.hom).mp
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using h
lean.statement:
public theorem representative_equation_iff
    (a : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (F.F s k))
    (b : T ⟶ Subobject.underlying.obj (G.F (s+n) k)) :
    a ≫ (F.F s k).arrow ≫ f.map k = b ≫ (G.F (s+n) k).arrow ↔
      (a ≫ (e.source.level s).hom) ≫ (F'.F s k').arrow ≫ f'.map k' =
        (b ≫ (e.target.level (s+n)).hom) ≫ (G'.F (s+n) k').arrow
lean.docstring: The chosen representatives transport along the actual level isomorphisms.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapTransport.relation_iff
lean.code:
public theorem relation_iff
    (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k)
    (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s+n) k) :
    FilteredMapExtension.Relation f k s n x y ↔
      FilteredMapExtension.Relation f' k' s n
        (x ≫ (e.source.gradedIso s).hom) (y ≫ (e.target.gradedIso (s+n)).hom) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hn, a, b, ha, hb, he⟩
    refine ⟨hn, a ≫ (e.source.level s).hom,
      b ≫ (e.target.level (s+n)).hom, ?_, ?_,
      (e.representative_equation_iff a b).mp he⟩
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← e.source.projection_comm, ← Category.assoc, ha]
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← e.target.projection_comm, ← Category.assoc, hb]
  · rintro ⟨hn, a, b, ha, hb, he⟩
    refine ⟨hn, a ≫ (e.source.level s).inv,
      b ≫ (e.target.level (s+n)).inv, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← e.source.projection_inv_comm, ← Category.assoc, ha]
      simp
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← e.target.projection_inv_comm, ← Category.assoc, hb]
      simp
    · apply (e.representative_equation_iff _ _).mpr
      simpa using he

    (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k)
    (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s+n) k) :
    FilteredMapExtension.Relation f k s n x y ↔
      FilteredMapExtension.Relation f' k' s n
        (x ≫ (e.source.gradedIso s).hom) (y ≫ (e.target.gradedIso (s+n)).hom)

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapTransport.indeterminacy_iff
lean.code:
public theorem indeterminacy_iff (z : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s+n) k) :
    z ∈ FilteredMapExtension.TargetIndeterminacy f k s n T ↔
      z ≫ (e.target.gradedIso (s+n)).hom ∈
        FilteredMapExtension.TargetIndeterminacy f' k' s n T := by
  simpa only [FilteredMapExtension.TargetIndeterminacy, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
    zero_comp] using e.relation_iff (0 : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k) z

public theorem essential_iff (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k)
    (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s+n) k) :
    FilteredMapExtension.Essential f k s n x y ↔
      FilteredMapExtension.Essential f' k' s n
        (x ≫ (e.source.gradedIso s).hom) (y ≫ (e.target.gradedIso (s+n)).hom) := by
  unfold FilteredMapExtension.Essential
  rw [e.relation_iff]
  have h := e.targetCoset_iff y (0 : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s+n) k)

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:crossing-transport
blocks.title: Transport of crossings and ESS differentials
blocks.body: A crossing is a higher-source-filtration essential extension whose target level crosses the selected bound. Such crossings are preserved by filtered transport. If all four filtrations are bounded and the test object is projective, transport also preserves the differential relation in the extension spectral sequences.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapTransport.noCrossing_iff
lean.code:
public theorem noCrossing_iff (s n : ℤ) (T : C) :
    NoCrossing f k s n T ↔ NoCrossing f' k' s n T := by
  apply not_congr
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, m, ha, hm, hmn, x, y, he⟩
    exact ⟨a, m, ha, hm, hmn, _, _, (e.essential_iff x y).mp he⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, m, ha, hm, hmn, x, y, he⟩
    refine ⟨a, m, ha, hm, hmn, x ≫ (e.source.gradedIso (s+a)).inv,
      y ≫ (e.target.gradedIso ((s+a)+m)).inv, ?_⟩
    apply (e.essential_iff _ _).mpr
    simpa using he
lean.statement:
public theorem noCrossing_iff (s n : ℤ) (T : C) :
    NoCrossing f k s n T ↔ NoCrossing f' k' s n T

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapTransport.NoCrossing
lean.code:
public def NoCrossing (f : FilteredMorphism F G) (k : ω) (s n : ℤ) (T : C) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ (a m : ℤ), 0 < a ∧ 0 ≤ m ∧ a + m ≤ n ∧
    ∃ (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded (s+a) k)
      (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded ((s+a)+m) k),
      FilteredMapExtension.Essential f k (s+a) m x y

An actual higher-source-filtration essential extension crossing the

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapTransport.differentialRelation_iff
lean.code:
public theorem differentialRelation_iff
    (hF : F.IsBounded) (hG : G.IsBounded)
    (hF' : F'.IsBounded) (hG' : G'.IsBounded)
    (s : ℤ) (n : ℕ) [Projective T]
    (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k)
    (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s+(n:ℤ)) k) :
    DifferentialRelation (FilteredMapExtension.sequence f hF hG k) n (s,1)
      (x ≫ (FilteredMapExtension.sourceIso f hF hG k s).inv)
      (y ≫ (FilteredMapExtension.targetIso f hF hG k s n).inv) ↔
    DifferentialRelation (FilteredMapExtension.sequence f' hF' hG' k') n (s,1)
      (x ≫ (e.source.gradedIso s).hom ≫
        (FilteredMapExtension.sourceIso f' hF' hG' k' s).inv)
      (y ≫ (e.target.gradedIso (s+(n:ℤ))).hom ≫
        (FilteredMapExtension.targetIso f' hF' hG' k' s n).inv) := by
  rw [FilteredMapExtension.differentialRelation_iff]
  rw [← Category.assoc x, ← Category.assoc y,
    FilteredMapExtension.differentialRelation_iff]
  exact e.relation_iff x y

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:pairing
blocks.title: Pairings of spectral sequences
blocks.body: A pairing is bilinear on every page, has a specified parity and compatible differential degrees, obeys the signed Leibniz rule, and descends through the actual common-cycle successor-page relation.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.NextPageRelation
lean.code:
public def NextPageRelation {R : Type u} [Ring R]
    (E : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ)) (r : ℤ)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E.Page r p) (y : E.Page (r + 1) p) : Prop :=
  let D := E.ssData p
  let n : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r - E.r₀).toNat
  let n' : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r + 1 - E.r₀).toNat
  ∃ z : (Subobject.underlying.obj (D.Z n') : ModuleCat R),
    (Subobject.ofLE (D.Z n') (D.Z n)
      (D.Z_anti (by
        change (↑(r - E.r₀).toNat : WithTop ℕ) ≤ ↑(r + 1 - E.r₀).toNat
        exact_mod_cast (show (r - E.r₀).toNat ≤ (r + 1 - E.r₀).toNat by omega))) ≫
      D.pageπ n) z = x ∧
      D.pageπ n' z = y

This uses one next-cycle representative for both quotient classes.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.SSPairing
lean.code:
public structure SSPairing (E₁ E₂ E₃ : SpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ)) where
  diffDeg_compatible : ∀ r : ℤ,
    E₁.diffDeg r = E₂.diffDeg r ∧ E₁.diffDeg r = E₃.diffDeg r
  parity : GradingParity
  pair : ∀ (r : ℤ) (k l : ℤ × ℤ),
    E₁.Page r k →ₗ[R] E₂.Page r l →ₗ[R] E₃.Page r (k + l)
  leibniz : ∀ (r : ℤ) (k l : ℤ × ℤ) (x : E₁.Page r k) (y : E₂.Page r l),
    E₃.d r (k + l) (pair r k l x y) =
      (transportPage E₃ r (by rw [(diffDeg_compatible r).2]; ac_rfl))
        (pair r (k + E₁.diffDeg r) l (E₁.d r k x) y) +
      (if parity k = 1 then (-1 : ℤ) else 1) •
        (transportPage E₃ r (by rw [← (diffDeg_compatible r).1, (diffDeg_compatible r).2]; ac_rfl))
          (pair r k (l + E₂.diffDeg r) x (E₂.d r l y))
  nextPage_compatible : ∀ (r : ℤ) (k l : ℤ × ℤ),
    E₁.r₀ ≤ r → E₂.r₀ ≤ r → E₃.r₀ ≤ r →
    ∀ (x : E₁.Page r k) (x' : E₁.Page (r + 1) k)
      (y : E₂.Page r l) (y' : E₂.Page (r + 1) l),
    NextPageRelation E₁ r k x x' → NextPageRelation E₂ r l y y' →
    NextPageRelation E₃ r (k + l) (pair r k l x y) (pair (r + 1) k l x' y')

blocks.label: sem:SpectralSequence:converging-pairing
blocks.title: Products from finite pages to the abutment
blocks.body: A converging pairing ties the finite-page products to one product on common infinite cycles, its induced $E_\infty$ product, the filtered abutment product, and the associated graded product. All comparisons use the same convergence isomorphisms.

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.ConvergingSSPairing
lean.code:
public structure ConvergingSSPairing
    (X₁ X₂ X₃ : ConvergingSS (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ) ℤ) where
  ssPairing : SSPairing X₁.E X₂.E X₃.E
  eInftyPair : ∀ k l : ℤ × ℤ,
    (X₁.E.ssData k).eInfty →ₗ[R] (X₂.E.ssData l).eInfty →ₗ[R]
      (X₃.E.ssData (k + l)).eInfty
  cyclePairAtInfinity : ∀ k l : ℤ × ℤ,
    InfiniteCycles X₁.E k →ₗ[R] InfiniteCycles X₂.E l →ₗ[R] InfiniteCycles X₃.E (k + l)
  eInftyPair_induced : ∀ (k l : ℤ × ℤ)
      (x : InfiniteCycles X₁.E k) (y : InfiniteCycles X₂.E l),
    (X₃.E.ssData (k + l)).pageπ ⊤ (cyclePairAtInfinity k l x y) =
      eInftyPair k l ((X₁.E.ssData k).pageπ ⊤ x) ((X₂.E.ssData l).pageπ ⊤ y)
  finitePagePair_compatible : ∀ (r : ℤ) (k l : ℤ × ℤ),
    X₁.E.r₀ ≤ r → X₂.E.r₀ ≤ r → X₃.E.r₀ ≤ r →
    ∀ (x : InfiniteCycles X₁.E k) (y : InfiniteCycles X₂.E l),
    ssPairing.pair r k l (infinityToPage X₁.E r k x) (infinityToPage X₂.E r l y) =
      infinityToPage X₃.E r (k + l) (cyclePairAtInfinity k l x y)
  abutmentPair : ∀ i j : ℤ, X₁.A i →ₗ[R] X₂.A j →ₗ[R] X₃.A (i + j)
  filteredAbutmentPair : ∀ s t i j : ℤ,
    FiltrationPiece X₁.F s i →ₗ[R] FiltrationPiece X₂.F t j →ₗ[R]
      FiltrationPiece X₃.F (s + t) (i + j)
  filteredAbutmentPair_compatible : ∀ (s t i j : ℤ)
      (x : FiltrationPiece X₁.F s i) (y : FiltrationPiece X₂.F t j),
    (X₃.F.F (s + t) (i + j)).arrow (filteredAbutmentPair s t i j x y) =
      abutmentPair i j ((X₁.F.F s i).arrow x) ((X₂.F.F t j).arrow y)
  associatedGradedPair : ∀ s t i j : ℤ,
    X₁.F.associatedGraded s i →ₗ[R] X₂.F.associatedGraded t j →ₗ[R]
      X₃.F.associatedGraded (s + t) (i + j)
  associatedGradedPair_induced : ∀ (s t i j : ℤ)
      (x : FiltrationPiece X₁.F s i) (y : FiltrationPiece X₂.F t j),
    associatedGradedPair s t i j (X₁.F.toAssociatedGraded s i x)
        (X₂.F.toAssociatedGraded t j y) =
      X₃.F.toAssociatedGraded (s + t) (i + j) (filteredAbutmentPair s t i j x y)
  reindex_compatible : ∀ k l : ℤ × ℤ,
    X₁.conv.reindex k + X₂.conv.reindex l = X₃.conv.reindex (k + l)
  eInfty_compatible : ∀ (k l : ℤ × ℤ)
      (x : (X₁.E.ssData k).eInfty) (y : (X₂.E.ssData l).eInfty),
    X₃.F.transportGraded (reindex_compatible k l).symm
      ((X₃.conv.iso (k + l)).hom (eInftyPair k l x y)) =
      associatedGradedPair (X₁.conv.reindex k).1 (X₂.conv.reindex l).1
        (X₁.conv.reindex k).2 (X₂.conv.reindex l).2
        ((X₁.conv.iso k).hom x) ((X₂.conv.iso l).hom y)

    associatedGradedPair s t i j (X₁.F.toAssociatedGraded s i x)
        (X₂.F.toAssociatedGraded t j y) =
      X₃.F.toAssociatedGraded (s + t) (i + j) (filteredAbutmentPair s t i j x y)
  reindex_compatible : ∀ k l : ℤ × ℤ,
    X₁.conv.reindex k + X₂.conv.reindex l = X₃.conv.reindex (k + l)
  eInfty_compatible : ∀ (k l : ℤ × ℤ)
      (x : (X₁.E.ssData k).eInfty) (y : (X₂.E.ssData l).eInfty),
    X₃.F.transportGraded (reindex_compatible k l).symm
      ((X₃.conv.iso (k + l)).hom (eInftyPair k l x y)) =
      associatedGradedPair (X₁.conv.reindex k).1 (X₂.conv.reindex l).1
        (X₁.conv.reindex k).2 (X₂.conv.reindex l).2
        ((X₁.conv.iso k).hom x) ((X₂.conv.iso l).hom y)

public def comp (f : ConvergingSequenceMorphism X Y) (g : ConvergingSequenceMorphism Y Z) :
    ConvergingSequenceMorphism X Z where
  sequence := f.sequence ≫ g.sequence
  convergence := @CategoryStruct.comp (ConvergingSS (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ℤ × ℤ) ℤ)
    _ X.underlying Y.underlying Z.underlying f.convergence g.convergence
  eInfty_compatible p := by
    change f.convergence.eMap p ≫ g.convergence.eMap p =
      (f.sequence ≫ g.sequence).eInftyMap p
    rw [f.eInfty_compatible, g.eInfty_compatible, SpectralSequenceMorphism.eInftyMap_comp]

blocks.label: paper:2.1
blocks.title: The extension spectral sequence
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Definition 2.1.)
                          

  For a map $f: X\to Y$, we define an $f$-extension spectral sequence (denoted $f$-ESS) as the spectral sequence derived from filtering the above chain complex according to the Adams filtration on $\pi_*$. The $E_0$-page of this spectral sequence is isomorphic to the direct sum of $E_\infty$-pages of the Adams spectral sequences of $X$ and $Y$: 
  $$\ESS{f}_0^{s,t} \cong E_\infty^{s,t}(X) \oplus E_\infty^{s,t}(Y) \Longrightarrow \Ker(\pi_*f)\oplus \Coker(\pi_*f)$$
  where the $d_0$-differential is induced by $f$ on the $E_\infty$-pages.
  
  Differentials in this spectral sequence has the form
  $$d_n^{f}: \ESS{f}_n^{s,t}\to \ESS{f}_n^{s+n, t+n}.$$

lean.name: KIP126.Core.SpectralSequence.FilteredMapExtension.differentialRelation_iff
lean.code:
public theorem differentialRelation_iff (f : FilteredMorphism F G)
    (hF : F.IsBounded) (hG : G.IsBounded) (k : ω) (s : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    {T : C} [Projective T] (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k)
    (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s + (n : ℤ)) k) :
    DifferentialRelation (sequence f hF hG k) n (s, 1)
      (x ≫ (sourceIso f hF hG k s).inv)
      (y ≫ (targetIso f hF hG k s n).inv) ↔ Relation f k s n x y := by
  rw [relation_iff_fiber, and_iff_right (Int.natCast_nonneg n)]
  change DifferentialRelation
    ((underlyingComplex f.map f.compat k).toSpectralSequence
      (underlyingComplexBounded f.map f.compat k hF hG)) n (s, 1)
    (x ≫ 𝟙 (F.associatedGraded s k)) (y ≫ 𝟙 (G.associatedGraded (s + ↑n) k)) ↔ _
  rw [Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id]
  exact
    FilteredComplex.Solutions.differentialRelation_iff_nonempty_fiber
      (underlyingComplex f.map f.compat k)
      (underlyingComplexBounded f.map f.compat k hF hG) n s 1 x y
lean.statement:
public theorem differentialRelation_iff (f : FilteredMorphism F G)
    (hF : F.IsBounded) (hG : G.IsBounded) (k : ω) (s : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
    {T : C} [Projective T] (x : T ⟶ F.associatedGraded s k)
    (y : T ⟶ G.associatedGraded (s + (n : ℤ)) k) :
    DifferentialRelation (sequence f hF hG k) n (s, 1)
      (x ≫ (sourceIso f hF hG k s).inv)
      (y ≫ (targetIso f hF hG k s n).inv) ↔ Relation f k s n x y
lean.docstring:
The actual ESS differential relation is precisely the original filtered-map
equation. Projectivity is retained when arbitrary morphism-valued labels are used.

blocks.label: paper:2.6
blocks.title: Vanishing below the Adams filtration
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 2.6.)
                          
If the Adams filtration of $f$ is $k$, then
    $d^f_i=0$ for $i<k$.

comments.author: blueprint-authoring

No public theorem asserting that $\operatorname{AF}(f)=k$ forces every $d_i^f$ with $i<k$ to vanish has been identified. The result `action\_filtration` provides related support but does not state this conclusion.
